notes: New items: when a shop has an item the watcher has never seen, hovering it once reads its full name off the tooltip, and from then on that item is read, priced and uploaded with its icon. Cut-off names also finish themselves from items other scanners found. Close your watcher and open start.bat to update.

history.notes: New items: when a shop has an item the watcher has never seen, hovering it once reads its full name off the tooltip, and from then on that item is read, priced and uploaded with its icon. Cut-off names also finish themselves from items other scanners found. Close your watcher and open start.bat to update.

FM Entrance reading: dark chalkboards (black, brown, purple) are read now, rolls like +2 or 65 watk are kept, (2) is read as how many they have, prices without a k are fixed, and a post read with one digit wrong (90K vs 30K) keeps the right one. Close your watcher and open start.bat to update.
Scan stats: the watcher prints your last hour and today (new listings, shops, sales caught, listings per active hour) at the top of every hour, and stats.bat shows them any time.
Hover wanted list now reads from the public price summary.
Hover wanted: the watcher now tells you (with a two-note chime) when a shop has an equip the board needs stats for. Just rest your mouse on that row.
Scrolled items whose tooltip title reads badly keep their stats: the row under the pointer is used. Fixes 10 attack Work Gloves showing no stats.
A short chime when a hovered item's stats are read, a low tone when a hover couldn't be read. Tooltips that open above the pointer are read too.
Reads the chalkboard posts over players' heads when you stand in the Free Market Entrance. Counted as asking prices, once a day per seller.
Prices from watchers without a GitHub key now go to Club FM's own private inbox instead of a shared sheet.
Scans now go to Club FM's private data repository, so listings stay private to members. Nothing to change on your end.

Your name: a name in config.json is never second-guessed, and a name read off the screen needs five matching reads that outvote every other guess (3-letter misreads like Toe no longer stick). Linked watchers show under the Discord account's in-game name.
Faster reading: the minimap is read once per look instead of once per shop frame, and each text reader keeps to one CPU thread so the readers stop fighting each other.

Channel changes are caught the moment you click a channel in the Change Channel window, not only when the loading screen is spotted. Bigger read queue and more readers on bigger CPUs so fast scrolling drops fewer shops.
Reminds you every 10 minutes to open the Change Channel window when no channel is known yet.
Startup text and README: your in-game name is read off the screen, nothing to type.
Reads your character's name off the status bar and uses it as your scanner name, so nothing to type. Still only looks at the screen.
Link your watcher to your Club FM account: put the code from maplefm.gg/earn in config.json as link_code.
Signed releases: the watcher now refuses any update not signed by Club FM. Inbox posts are signed too, so nobody can post prices as you.
The site moved to maplefm.gg.
Updates itself while running. No more reopening start.bat.
Reads the new 40-channel window and FM rooms up to 20.
Adds export.bat, which writes everything you've scanned to a spreadsheet file.
Sends your saved scans from the past week the first time it starts.
Better at telling which items sold.
Reads stats of items linked in trade chat.
Reads shops faster.
Small fixes.
Better equipment stat reading.
Fixes uploads that stopped when you scan a lot of shops.
Small fixes.
